The '''Gauntlet''' was a light-speed cannon that was capable of eliminating hyperspace targets. It was created using the power and materials extracted by the [[Sun Razer]] in the [[Vesla system/Legends|Vesla system]]. One of its notable designers was [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Rebus (Sith Empire)|Rebus]]. Using the Sun Razer, the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] was able to complete its creation in years instead of decades. All the projects fueled by the Sun Razer were overseen by [[Darth Mekhis]] and discovered by [[Theron Shan]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ngani Zho]] upon their infiltration and capture in the [[Vesla system/Legends|Vesla system]].

By the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the Republic became aware of the Gauntlet's existence and the Empire's intent to mass-produce it. Thus, they prepared a joint strike force to take it down. While a Republic fleet engaged the Gauntlet, [[Havoc Squad]] and the [[Safecrackers]] infiltrated and sabotaged the superweapon from within and escaped before it was destroyed. Unfortunately, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Arkos Rakton]] used the Gauntlet's destruction as an excuse to launch a campaign against the Republic.
